text: Which account was the lamp delivery at door 6, Pellow or Pellucid? Kwame and I went round on this in February.
reply_text: @Sofia Marchetti, it was Pellow. In #coastal-team on Feb 17, Kwame said your retail account was the one showing the lamp delivery at door 6, and you confirmed it. That was Pellow Home Living, which was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail. The Gulf Coast terminal rows, including the container pickup, belong to Pellucid Harbor Logistics.
